Bid Summary.value: The State of Maryland Treasurer’s Office’s bid “Dell Laptops w/Extended Warranty” (#E20P4600040; BPM044557; 00004079359) uses the Desktop, Laptop and Tablet 2015 Master Contract, 060B5400007. It calls for 30 Dell Latitude 5550 laptops and 30 Dell Thunderbolt 4 Docks (WD22TB4); the laptops include Windows 11 Pro and a three-year Dell Limited Hardware Warranty extension. Electronic submissions through eMaryland Marketplace Advantage (eMMA) were due June 10, 2024, at 2:00 PM EDT, and quotes must remain valid for at least 90 days after that date. Delivery is required within 45 days of award to 80 Calvert Street, Room 109, Annapolis, MD 21401. The Master Contractor must be an authorized Dell reseller; a Mercury Affidavit is required, a manufacturer or distributor Letter of Authorization may be requested, and a warranty certificate or affidavit must be presented upon award. Invoices must be emailed to STOaccountspayable@treasurer.state.md.us within 10 days of equipment delivery and include the specified contractor, purchase-order, invoice, delivery, and serial-number information.
